definitions.gloss: path; route; the way one passes
definitions.explanation: The way people, animals or things pass along, or a place on one's usual route. Also used of the paths of wind, water and typhoons ({台風|たいふう}の{通|とお}り{道|みち}), and in {通|とお}り{道|みち}だから (it's on my way).

examples.japanese: {通|とお}り{道|みち}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's on my way, so I'll drop you at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: This area often lies in the path of typhoons, and there is damage every year.

notes:
⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to pass) + ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (way).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通|とお}り{道|みち}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since it's on the way
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{道|みち}: the path of typhoons
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{道|みち}: a channel for the breeze
- {通|とお}り{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふさぐ: to block the way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: a street, a road with a name; {通|とお}り{道|みち} is any route something takes
